mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tags (name) VALUES (#{name}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tag_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(tag_id)
mapper.select: SELECT tag_id, name, created_at FROM tags WHERE name = #{name}

SELECT t.tag_id, t.name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question_tags qt WHERE qt.tag_id = t.tag_id) AS question_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM note_tags nt WHERE nt.tag_id = t.tag_id) AS note_count FROM tags t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM question_tags qt WHERE qt.tag_id = t.tag_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM note_tags nt WHERE nt.tag_id = t.tag_id) ORDER BY (question_count + note_count) DESC, t.name LIMIT #{limit}
